assessment_kind: independent collaborating-agent source and live HTTP assessment
not_claimed: Paid service operational when readiness is false

findings.title: Public discovery and operational ownership need clear task and role boundaries
source_evidence: braink-development.mjs: developmentPage exposes owner sign-in with all controls visible
dist/server/index.js: public BRAINK entry appends IDE/CLI/CI links
page-experience.mjs: public directory shows owner editor links
findings.proposed_fix: Introduce a sector with clearly labelled public services, working utilities, research and owner operations. Explain which actions require the existing owner account without changing native authority.
verification_tasks: Anonymous visitor can find one usable utility in at most two navigation decisions
Public user can distinguish an owner-only runtime operation before submitting it
Every existing application deep link remains reachable

findings.title: Runtime errors appear as untranslated machine codes
source_evidence: braink-development.mjs: perform renders error.message and hides auth unless AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
braink-architecture.mjs: perform renders error.message
live architecture API: 401 AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
findings.proposed_fix: Map known status codes to actionable language with retry/sign-in/context-specific recovery. Retain expandable raw diagnostics. Preserve editor content and queued job identity.
verification_tasks: 401 shows owner sign-in and return path
403 explains correct-account requirement
503/network failure preserves entered text and offers retry
Job readback failure does not resubmit an existing job

findings.title: Repeated controls and raw evidence impose avoidable cognitive work
source_evidence: braink-architecture.mjs: ten rows use identical Run and Inspect labels
braink-development.mjs: job table buttons all say Inspect
both operational pages primarily render JSON in pre
findings.proposed_fix: Give contextual accessible button names and concise result summaries: operation, observed state, source identity, time, next action. Expand raw evidence on demand.
verification_tasks: Accessible name uniquely identifies each operation
Last observation and pending execution remain distinguishable
User can locate a failed stage and its retry route without reading the entire JSON document

findings.title: Primary learning CTAs do not match every market task
source_evidence: landing-router.mjs: each audience CTA routes to /learn and says Learn the architecture
page-experience.mjs: information pages receive learning-interest CTA
interest.mjs: actual D1-backed learning registration
findings.proposed_fix: Separate useful software, project/service enquiry and learning registration as explicit task choices. Keep existing consent and D1 persistence intact.
verification_tasks: Tool seeker reaches a runtime workspace without registering interest
Learning subscriber receives retained success/failure state
Project enquiry is labelled accurately as enquiry rather than a deployed service purchase

findings.title: Operational pages lack a skip link and current-location treatment
source_evidence: braink-development.mjs: header before main, no skip link or main id
braink-development.mjs: no aria-current navigation attribute
braink-architecture.mjs: aria-current exists but no skip link
findings.proposed_fix: Add skip-to-main, current navigation, meaningful headings, contextual table labels and details regions. Maintain visible focus and native controls.
verification_tasks: Keyboard first focus offers skip link
Skip moves focus to main content
Current section announced by assistive technology
All actions complete through keyboard without pointer-only interactions

findings.title: Mobile operational tables may obscure context and actions
source_evidence: braink-architecture.mjs: at <=760px each th/td min-width 140px, table wrapper scrolls
braink-development.mjs: <=700px table becomes horizontal overflow block
findings.proposed_fix: Provide a mobile card or stacked row presentation preserving semantic relationships; keep technical evidence wrap and support zoom.
verification_tasks: At 320/375/768px no page-level horizontal overflow
At 200% zoom essential status/action pairs remain visible
Keyboard horizontal content remains reachable
Touch targets measured at least 44x44 CSS pixels as a project design target

findings.title: Paid ClaimPath availability must reflect actual billing readiness
source_evidence: GET /api/claimpath/billing -> HTTP200 {ready:false,label:null}
claimpath-delivery.mjs: missing configured payment bindings cause 503 and no paid download
findings.proposed_fix: Use existing readiness endpoint for market/service availability. Link working browser workspace separately from paid delivery; expose meaningful unavailable state and support route.
verification_tasks: Unavailable payment state never produces a purchase-success claim
Configured paid state requires verified real payment/entitlement path
Browser utility remains usable when payment configuration is absent

findings.title: Luxury visual consistency must extend across real service journeys
source_evidence: Live homepage HTML 36448 bytes; development page 6121 bytes
landing-router.mjs: audience visual themes differ from operational navy/system-ui layout
findings.proposed_fix: Use a shared restrained visual system with coherent typography, generous spacing, high-contrast accents and predictable navigation. Do not hide working controls or replace them with decorative service promises.
verification_tasks: Compare home/sector/utility/runtime at desktop and mobile
Measure text and control contrast against WCAG2.2 AA thresholds
Motion honors prefers-reduced-motion
Decorative graphics have alternatives and do not block task execution

findings.title: IDE action latency and save conflict require user-oriented state
source_evidence: braink-development.mjs: file actions poll up to120 seconds; new-file resets revision
braink-development.mjs: save uses one global revision variable
native relay is an asynchronous execution queue
findings.proposed_fix: Track active path/revision and explicit saving, queued, running, completed and conflicting-save states. Warn only on actual unsaved edits before replacing content. Keep retry bound to original job.
verification_tasks: Two-file switching cannot attach stale revision to a different file
Conflict preserves local text and offers reload/comparison
Slow jobs remain inspectable after polling returns
Rapid duplicate clicks do not produce unintended duplicate saves

findings.title: Usability claims require actual participant evidence
source_evidence: No participant sessions or human study measurements performed in this assessment
findings.proposed_fix: Run consented task-based research with representative tool users, technical operators and service buyers; include accessibility needs. Record qualitative failures and actual completion measures rather than invented averages.
verification_tasks: Pilot moderated sessions with tasks below
Recruit actual participants separately from automated testing
Report sample characteristics, task outcomes, exact denominators and limitations
Iterate observed blockers and rerun changed tasks

usability_research_plan.participant_recruitment: Recruit actual representative service buyers, utility users and technical operators, including keyboard and assistive technology users. Start a pilot of roughly five participants per distinct audience; that is a planning choice, not a population-level efficacy claim.
usability_research_plan.consent: Explain purpose, voluntary participation, collected data and retention; avoid real private workspace information in research tasks.

tasks.task: Find and open a working tool suitable for organising files
tasks.success: Working storage application opened; user understands persistence/export scope

tasks.task: Identify a relevant service and prepare an enquiry without confusing it with a purchase
tasks.success: Correct service/enquiry route with accurate delivery expectations

tasks.task: Inspect latest architecture evidence and identify an unresolved operation
tasks.success: Correct state/source/time and next action identified

tasks.task: Queue a clean sector build, locate its result and download a verified artifact
tasks.success: Actual queued -> executed -> retained result -> artifact download, hash verified

tasks.task: Navigate sector, select utility and read operation outcome without pointer input
tasks.success: No keyboard trap; meaningful control names and announced state

tasks.task: Use a utility and inspect failed service operation at 375px width
tasks.success: Inputs/status/actions visible; failure can be recovered without losing work

usability_research_plan.reporting: Separate observed session evidence, automated verification and design interpretation. Publish actual denominators and limitations; no synthetic success rates.

engineering_verification_plan: Execute existing native route and store tests with new sector tests
Run realistic DOM interactions with actual owner/anonymous API states
Use browser screenshots and keyboard traversal at 320/375/768/1440px
Run axe-core against rendered pages and manual screen-reader checks where available
Measure performance in real browser with network/device conditions recorded; do not substitute source file size for Core Web Vitals
Verify public service readiness through deployed APIs and owned runtime effects
Retain route/status/source revision and digest evidence for release readback
